thread:
maria: Hey team — follow-up from yesterday's postmortem for customer Cascade. Capturing action items for VPC peering flaps and the on-prem isolation bug. I can take ownership of tracking, want to confirm owners/timelines.

ajay: thanks. can we list the high-priority actions? I think there are 4.

maria: yep — short list:
1) Harden BGP session retries on customer edge (owner: kevin, ETA: 2024-08-10)
2) Add health-check fallback routing to dedicated pool (owner: sarah, ETA: 2024-07-30)
3) Triage on-prem KV cache corruption root cause (owner: ben, ETA: 2024-07-20)
4) Run tenant isolation test harness against latest kernel (owner: lisa, ETA: 2024-07-15)

kevin: ack owner. I'll open a runbook PR and add config flags. link: https://redwood.atlassian/browse/INF-4321

sarah: I'll prototype route fallback today. Quick Q: do we prefer soft-fail to dedicated fallback or immediate reroute?

maria: prefer soft fail (5s) then reroute; reason: avoid flapping. Add metric: vpc_peering.flap_count

ben: found a repro for KV corruption, logging in thread ->
```
ERROR kv_op: checksum mismatch at shard 7
stack: kv::apply -> kv::merge -> net::recv
context: heavy on-prem I/O + abrupt restart
```
I need infra access to mount debug image — @eng-ops can you grant?

oncall-bot: ENG-OPS access request created: #REQ-9876

eng-ops: granted on staging for 48h. ping when done.

lisa: isolation harness run scheduled weekly. I'll add a dedicated customer case with cascade topology. ETA: 7/15.

ajay: can we get a single flat owner for remediation complete sign-off? Suggest maria for final acceptance.

maria: fine. I'll be remediations owner. Please add timeline updates to the ticket INF-4321 and post weekly status in this thread. I will compile for the customer.

kevin: putting a PR link: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/2147

sarah: initial prototype pushed to sandbox. will post perf numbers by Wed.

maria: thanks. Next sync Thu 10am PT. If any blocker escalate in this thread or @maria.

ajay: noted. :thumbsup:
